summary: No law, enforcement action, incident or institutional practice specific to Nizhny Novgorod Oblast concerning transgender people is documented in the available sources. The national assessment for Russia applies without regional qualification.
tangentialFactors: The sources consulted are national in scope. The UK Home Office country policy and information note on sexual orientation and gender identity and expression records no facts at oblast level, and the Human Rights Watch count of extremism-related convictions is a nationwide figure that is not disaggregated by region, so it cannot be used to estimate enforcement levels in Nizhny Novgorod.
localsOnly: No regional rule, regional institution or regional practice bearing on transgender residents of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast was identified. Residents are subject to the national legal regime; no regional provision altering it was found in the sources reviewed.
outOfScopeNotes: Whether prosecutors or courts in Nizhny Novgorod have brought cases under the propaganda or extremism statutes is not sourced. No regional case figures, regional detention reporting, regional healthcare directives or regional facilities policy were identified. The absence of documentation is not evidence that no enforcement occurs.
